headline: Stardust Dragon
title: Stardust Dragon Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Stardust Dragon. What is it? It is a Level eight WIND Dragon Synchro Monster with two thousand five hundred attack. It is Yusei's key card. What does it do? When a card or effect that would destroy a card on the field is activated, you can tribute Stardust Dragon to negate and destroy it, then bring it back in the End Phase. How do you use it? Synchro Summon it with one Tuner plus non-Tuner monsters whose Levels add up to eight. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
